Testing & Verification

Casper uses an 8-tier pytest suite orchestrated by scripts/verify.sh, paired with static quality checks and deterministic generator checks.

Verification Gate (scripts/verify.sh)

scripts/verify.sh emits a single summary line (PASS ... or FAIL ...) to stdout and writes per-stage logs, summary.tsv, junit.xml, and report.md into target/verify/.

bash
# Fast pre-commit gate: ruff, mypy, spec-sync, secret-scan, smoke, unit
scripts/verify.sh --quick

# Pre-milestone gate: specific test tiers
scripts/verify.sh --tier smoke,unit,integration,system,security

# Full pre-release gate: lint, mypy, spec-sync, secret-scan, all 8 tiers, coverage
scripts/verify.sh

# Additional modes
scripts/verify.sh --only tests/unit/test_web_app.py
scripts/verify.sh --match "golden" --tier integration
scripts/verify.sh --failed
scripts/verify.sh --status
scripts/verify.sh --report

Coverage Thresholds

The full scripts/verify.sh gate runs pytest tests --cov=src/casper --cov-branch and enforces:

  • Line coverage: >= 90.00%
  • Branch coverage: >= 85.00%

8-Tier Test Layout (tests/)

TierDirectoryScope
smoketests/smoke/Architecture rank DAG (test_architecture.py), ADR parity (test_adr.py), brand sync (test_brand.py), CLI boot (test_cli_boot.py), repo hygiene & relative links (test_hygiene.py), spec sync (test_spec.py), verify gate (test_verify_gate.py)
unittests/unit/Module-level tests for catalog, conformance, errors, facts, layers, libraries, loaders, modalities, planner, profile, realizer, validator, web
integrationtests/integration/Cross-module determinism (test_determinism.py), 11-combo golden matrix (test_golden.py), CLI backend integration (test_llm.py), Hypothesis property tests (test_properties.py)
systemtests/system/End-to-end CLI (test_cli_e2e.py), surface parity (test_surface_parity.py), real-socket Web UI E2E (test_web_e2e.py)
securitytests/security/Global constraints (test_constraints.py), zero-invention fidelity (test_fidelity.py), loader SSRF/traversal/zip-bomb guards (test_loaders_security.py), .local.yaml privacy (test_privacy.py), HTTP security headers/bounds (test_web_security.py)
perftests/perf/Latency budgets (test_latency_budgets.py)
stresstests/stress/Realizer candidate/size bounds (test_realizer_bounds.py), web concurrency (test_web_concurrency.py)
torturetests/torture/Atomic save crash recovery (test_atomic_save.py), loader fault injection (test_loader_faults.py), web socket/protocol faults (test_web_faults.py)

Offline Network Guard & @pytest.mark.loopback

tests/conftest.py installs an autouse=True fixture (_offline_socket_guard) that monkeypatches socket.socket.connect, socket.socket.connect_ex, and socket.create_connection to raise RuntimeError on any outbound network attempt (AF_UNIX remains allowed).

Real-socket end-to-end tests against 127.0.0.1 / ::1 / localhost must opt in explicitly with @pytest.mark.loopback.

Fake CLI Writer (tests/fakes/fake_agent.py)

tests/fakes/fake_agent.py is an offline test double for claude and agy driven by CASPER_FAKE_MODE across 9 modes:

CASPER_FAKE_MODEBehavior
goodEmits valid grounded sentences citing each [fNNN] fact ID
rewordApplies benign lexical rewording while keeping polarity and citations
inventInjects an ungrounded metric ($999,999) to trigger validator rejection
renameInjects an ungrounded proper noun (ZorgCorp) to trigger validator rejection
polarityInverts sentence polarity (on track → blocked)
uncitedOmits [fNNN] citation on the first sentence
emptyOutputs whitespace only
failExits non-zero (1) simulating auth/CLI failure
hangSleeps for CASPER_FAKE_SLEEP seconds (default 5.0) to exercise timeouts

Set CASPER_FAKE_DUMP_PROMPT=<path> to inspect the exact prompt passed to the CLI writer (e.g., to verify private .local.yaml data is absent).

Golden Output Regeneration

tests/integration/test_golden.py compares all 11 valid structure × modality pairs against tests/golden/. After intentional output changes, regenerate golden snapshots with:

bash
CASPER_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 .venv/bin/pytest tests/integration/test_golden.py -q

Sync & Hygiene Checks

Run these deterministic drift and hygiene checks whenever editing specs, brand generators, examples, or docs:

bash
# Spec compilation sync (spec/0[0-9]-*.md -> SPEC.md)
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_spec.py --check

# Brand asset sync (docs/brand/ + src/casper/web/static/img/)
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_brand.py --check

# Worked examples sync (examples/edge-migration-status.md -> examples/outputs/)
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_examples.py --check

# Secret & machine-specific path scan
bash scripts/scan_secrets_and_paths.sh
